title: Spicy Mexican Street Corn Tacos
description: A delicious and flavorful taco recipe filled with grilled corn, crispy taco meat, and a sprinkle of nutty queso fresco.
instructions: Grill corn on the cob for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes.
Cook taco meat in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add cumin and chili powder to the taco meat and stir to combine.
Season taco meat with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning taco meat onto a tortilla, followed by a grilled corn slice and a sprinkle of queso fresco.
Drizzle lime juice over the top and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
